name: Route 133
lines:
Why, hello, hellooo, little visiting Trainer!
Greetings to you out here in the big blue!
Now, I know you know that a Psychic Trainer
like me can see riiiiiight through any foe.
I can tell exactly how strong you are
and how a battle between us would go...
just by lookin’ at you! It’s eerie, right?
Now stand back and watch as I battle you
within my mind!

...
Yowza! You did me right in!
Take this, and have mercy!

Phew... That was bad. So eerie.
I couldn’t even get a hit in on you!
Seriously, tell me: What are you?
